learning_outcomes.text: Can solve two or three-dimensional problems using equilibrium equations.
Can calculate the moment of a force about a specific axis.
Can analyze simple truss systems using the method of joints and method of sections.
Can determine the position of the center of gravity and geometric center for particle systems and objects.
Can calculate the moment of inertia of an area.
Can draw shear force diagrams and bending moment diagrams.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Mechanics, Basic Concepts and Principles; Statics of Particles, Force Vectors: (Vector Operations, Sum of Force Vectors, Sum of Planar Forces, Cartesian Vectors, Unit Vector, Sum of Cartesian Vectors)
Force Vectors (Cont.) & Position Vectors (Force Vector Directed Along a Line, Scalar Product, Angle Between Two Vectors, Parallel and Perpendicular Components of a Vector Along a Line)
Particle Equilibrium: Free Body Diagram, Planar (2D) and 3-Dimensional (3D) Force Systems

Resultants of a Force System: Moment of a Force, Vector Product, Varignon's Theorem, Moment of a Force About an Axis, Moment of a Couple, Simplification of Force and Couple, Resultant, Further Simplification (Concurrent, Planar, Parallel Forces, Reduction to a Wrench), Distributed Loads (Single Axis, Magnitude and Location of Resultant Forces)
Rigid Body Equilibrium: 2D Support Reactions, External and Internal Forces, Center of Gravity, Idealized Models, FBD, Equilibrium Equations, Two- and Three-Force Members and 3D Topic Explanation
Rigid Body Equilibrium (Cont.): 3D Examples & Structural Analysis: Simple Trusses, Method of Joints, Zero-Force Members
Structural Analysis (Cont.): Method of Sections, Cremona Method, Space Trusses, Frames and Machines
Internal Forces: Shear Force and Bending Moment Diagrams
Internal Forces (Cont.): Shear Force and Bending Moment Diagrams, Distributed Load, Relationships Between Shear Force and Moment, Cables
Friction: Normal Force, Friction Force, Coefficient of Friction, Characteristics of Dry Friction
Center of Gravity and Geometric Center: Center of Gravity & Mass for a Particle: Center of Gravity, Mass & Geometric for a Body, Composite Bodies, Pappus and Guldinus Theorems
Examples of Center of Gravity & Geometric Center (Cont.) & Moments of Inertia: Parallel Axis Theorem & Radius of Gyration of an Area, Integration Calculation, Composite Areas, Product of Inertia
Moments of Inertia, Examples of Moments of Inertia for Composite Areas (Cont.)
bibliography: Beer and Johnston, Vector Mechanics for Engineers: Statics, McGraw Hill.
R. C. Hibbeler Mühendislik Mekaniği: Statik
